mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `t_order` ( id, user_id, package_id, campaign_id, amount, discount, pay_amount, status, payment_method, payment_time, source, remark, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{packageId}, #{campaignId}, #{amount}, #{discount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentTime}, #{source}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * from t_order_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(current_period.pay_amount), 0) as totalAmount, IFNULL(COUNT(current_period.id), 0) as totalOrders, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT current_period.user_id), 0) as totalUsers, IFNULL(AVG(current_period.pay_amount), 0) as averageAmount,
( SELECT CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(last_period.pay_amount), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((IFNULL(SUM(current_period.pay_amount), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(last_period.pay_amount), 0)) / IFNULL(SUM(last_period.pay_amount), 0) * 100, 2) END FROM t_order current_period LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, pay_amount FROM t_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{lastPeriodStart} AND #{lastPeriodEnd} ) last_period ON 1=1 WHERE current_period.create_time BETWEEN #{currentPeriodStart} AND #{currentPeriodEnd} ) as 'comparedToLastPeriod.amount',
( SELECT CASE WHEN IFNULL(COUNT(last_period.id), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((IFNULL(COUNT(current_period.id), 0) - IFNULL(COUNT(last_period.id), 0)) / IFNULL(COUNT(last_period.id), 0) * 100, 2) END FROM t_order current_period LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id FROM t_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{lastPeriodStart} AND #{lastPeriodEnd} ) last_period ON 1=1 WHERE current_period.create_time BETWEEN #{currentPeriodStart} AND #{currentPeriodEnd} ) as 'comparedToLastPeriod.orders',
( SELECT CASE WHEN IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT last_period.user_id), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT current_period.user_id), 0) - IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT last_period.user_id), 0)) / IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT last_period.user_id), 0) * 100, 2) END FROM t_order current_period LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM t_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{lastPeriodStart} AND #{lastPeriodEnd} ) last_period ON 1=1 WHERE current_period.create_time BETWEEN #{currentPeriodStart} AND #{currentPeriodEnd} ) as 'comparedToLastPeriod.users'
FROM t_order current_period WHERE current_period.create_time BETWEEN #{currentPeriodStart} AND #{currentPeriodEnd}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) as total_sales, COUNT(*) as total_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user) as total_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_package) as total_packages FROM t_order

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, SUM(pay_amount) as sales, COUNT(*) as orders, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as users FROM t_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day
SELECT pt.name as name, COUNT(o.id) as value FROM t_order o JOIN t_package p ON o.package_id = p.id JOIN t_package_type pt ON p.type = pt.id GROUP BY pt.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT p.id as id, p.name as name, COUNT(o.id) as sales, ROUND((COUNT(o.id) / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) * 100), 0) as growth FROM t_order o JOIN t_package p ON o.package_id = p.id WHERE o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT o.id as id, o.package_name as packageName, pt.name as packageType, o.pay_amount as amount, o.payment_method as paymentMethod, o.source as source, CASE o.status WHEN 0 THEN '待支付' WHEN 1 THEN '已支付' WHEN 2 THEN '已取消' WHEN 3 THEN '已退款' WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' ELSE '未知' END as status, DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime FROM t_order o JOIN t_package p ON o.package_id = p.id JOIN t_package_type pt ON p.type = pt.id ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT source as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM t_order GROUP BY source ORDER BY value DESC

choose.when: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, SUM(pay_amount) as amount, COUNT(*) as order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as user_count FROM t_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(create_time), '-', LPAD(WEEK(create_time, 1), 2, '0')) as date, SUM(pay_amount) as amount, COUNT(*) as order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as user_count FROM t_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY YEAR(create_time), WEEK(create_time, 1) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as date, SUM(pay_amount) as amount, COUNT(*) as order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as user_count FROM t_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY date
choose.otherwise: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, SUM(pay_amount) as amount, COUNT(*) as order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as user_count FROM t_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

mapper.select: SELECT p.name as name, COUNT(o.id) as value FROM t_order o JOIN t_package p ON o.package_id = p.id WHERE o.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT payment_method as method, COUNT(*) as value FROM t_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY value DESC
